nodes.label: Responsive Async Work Protocol
nodes.rationale: Every user-triggered async action gives immediate feedback; non-interactive work over 3s becomes durable background work so it survives navigation, reload, and browser closure.

nodes.label: Voice Copilot Coverage
nodes.rationale: Every signed-in screen must be discoverable and operable by voice with stable references, verified navigation, and confirmed mutations.

nodes.label: LivePreview Removal
nodes.rationale: LivePreview duplicated ReviewStep summary plus maintenance cost (flash sync, jump focus, mobile Sheet); consolidating at Review removes waste per LeanUX.

nodes.label: Conversion Loop (agents-calls-campaigns-customers)
nodes.rationale: Agents, calls, and campaigns exist to turn leads into real customers; vertical-flexible loop proven in property.

nodes.label: Durable Job System
nodes.rationale: Slow work must survive navigation, reload, and closure; creator-scoped durable jobs with global status and retry.

nodes.label: Voni Design System
nodes.rationale: Calm operator-first workspace for configuring voice agents, launching campaigns, and reviewing durable work; quiet precise dependable control room, monochrome-first semantic tokens.

nodes.label: Durable Job System (src/lib/jobs)
nodes.rationale: 202 plus job id, global job center, creator-scoped visibility, with result destination, retry path, and sanitized failure state.

nodes.label: Per-Item Pending State Pattern
nodes.rationale: Track pendingId per row so acting on one row does not visually disable every other row without indicating which action runs.

nodes.label: Responsive Async Work Protocol
nodes.rationale: Anything non-interactive exceeding 3 seconds must be a durable job surviving navigation, reload, and closed tab; spinners, useTransition, toasts, and loading.tsx are only immediate feedback, never durability.

nodes.label: Route loading.tsx and error.tsx Contract
nodes.rationale: Server Component routes awaiting data ship loading.tsx from page-skeletons shaped to layout plus error.tsx rendering RouteError with Next 16 retry callback.

nodes.label: Visual Feedback Protocol
nodes.rationale: Every async trigger must be visibly responsive because a click that just sits reads as broken, not busy; disable plus pending spinner, surface success and failure distinctly.

nodes.label: Component Vocabulary and Composition Contract
nodes.rationale: Blocks-anchored not literal Blocks-only; shadcn base-nova with Base UI primitives and Tailwind v4 tokens; render prop composition never asChild.

nodes.label: Product Safety and Async Behavior
nodes.rationale: Work over three seconds is a durable creator-scoped job with destination, retry, and sanitized failure; loading, rate-limit, mic, and hang-up states stay truthful and distinct; voice mutations follow propose read-back confirm.

nodes.label: Prohibited Drift and Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: No arbitrary palette, text sizes, bespoke dark styling, space-x/y, asChild, sonner, new chart or animation systems without explicit amendment; verify desktop and 390px mobile plus gates.
nodes.norm_label: prohibited drift and definition of done

nodes.label: Semantic Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Components consume semantic tokens rather than literal colors; same roles in light and dark, OS preference default with override.

nodes.label: Typography Rules (Geist)
nodes.rationale: Geist for UI text and Geist Mono for identifiers; short direct sentence-case labels, Tailwind default scale, no one-off micro-type.

nodes.label: Confirmation and Independent Assent Protocol
nodes.rationale: Edits propose before application with readback plus separate assent; Apply cannot be synthetically tapped; reordered controls keep identity while replacements and changed effects fail closed.

nodes.label: Record Search Durable Job
nodes.rationale: Record search may exceed three seconds so it becomes a record_search job returning 202 with job id, creator-scoped with opaque refs, recoverable after reload at /jobs search.

nodes.label: Cache Components Adoption
nodes.rationale: Direct one-branch flag enable with zero instant=false; every page gets a shell and content contract with immediate shell plus streaming leaves.

nodes.label: Partial Prefetching Adoption
nodes.rationale: Global flag with zero route prefetch exports and no codemod; no legacy prefetch contract found in audit.

nodes.label: Field and ToggleGroup Composition Migration
nodes.rationale: Replace raw div grid plus Label wrappers with FieldGroup plus Field and manual active-state loops with ToggleGroup 2-7, preserving names, values, validation, and invariants.

nodes.label: Sonner to Base UI Toast Migration
nodes.rationale: Migrate all toast call sites to Base UI toast.add with texts, actions, IDs, and dedup preserved; remove sonner component and dependency.
nodes.norm_label: sonner to base ui toast migration

nodes.label: Proactive Application Resolution Workflow
nodes.rationale: Start with one clear fixable missing item: narrow, measurable time to resolution, reversible explain-send-schedule actions, safe with no approval decision, reusable across banking insurance government.

nodes.label: Governed Case Resolution Strategy
nodes.rationale: Do not compete with ElevenLabs on generic voice features; ElevenLabs runs the conversation while Voni governs the case the conversation may advance: what is allowed, recorded, and finished.

nodes.label: Provider Adapter Independence
nodes.rationale: Standard connection for speech, phone, language, transfer, transcript, and quality lets Voni change voice, phone, or model suppliers without losing the case.

nodes.label: Safe Execution Path (Propose to Reconcile)
nodes.rationale: Every important action follows propose, read back, confirm, authorize, execute, record, reconcile so auditors can reconstruct what happened.

nodes.label: Cartesia TTS Voice Mismatch Limitation
nodes.rationale: AssemblyAI managed Voice Agent API has a closed voice catalog with no standalone TTS, so Cartesia WhatsApp voice-note voice cannot match the call voice; pick a stylistic match and revisit only if cross-channel voice identity becomes priority.

nodes.label: .dev.vars Bridge (Cloudflare Context)
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare OpenNext reads .dev.vars via Cloudflare context not process.env, so next.config.ts mirrors it in dev and secret() falls back at request time; DATABASE_URL alone lives in .env.local via Neon CLI.

nodes.label: LLM Fallback Chain (Meta plus Free Providers)
nodes.rationale: Try premium Meta Model API muse-spark-1.3-contributor first, then continue through Groq, Cerebras, Gemini, OpenRouter on timeout, error, or invalid JSON; OpenAI-compatible chat completions shape matches AssemblyAI Voice Agent llm field.
nodes.norm_label: llm fallback chain (meta plus free providers)
